title: Marketing CTAs send every environment to hey.chattic.us
description:
## Problem
dev.chattic.us and staging.chattic.us serve marketing at `/`. Header, hero, footer, and final CTA hardcode `https://hey.chattic.us`. Signing in from development lands on production.

## Convention (not configuration)
The product app is always at **`/chat` on the current host**. Marketing CTAs are same-origin `/chat`. Do not bake `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` workspace URLs, env switches, or hostname lists.

Production already rewrites `hey.chattic.us/` to `/chat`. Named-env hosts (`dev.`, `staging.`) keep marketing at `/` and the app at `/chat`. CloudFront must rewrite `/chat` → `/chat/index.html` on every host, not only `hey.`.

Apex `chattic.us` CTAs become `https://chattic.us/chat` (same convention). `hey.chattic.us/` remains the product-only hostname.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Marketing links to this host's app
  As a visitor on any Chatticus marketing host
  I want workspace CTAs to open the app on this same host
  So that development never signs me into production

  Scenario: Development marketing CTA is same-origin /chat
    Given the marketing page is served from "dev.chattic.us"
    Then the workspace CTA href is "/chat"
    And the workspace CTA href is not "https://hey.chattic.us"

  Scenario: CloudFront rewrites /chat on development
    Given the CloudFront viewer-request function for development
    When the request host is "dev.chattic.us" and the uri is "/chat"
    Then the rewritten uri is "/chat/index.html"
```

## Out of scope
Seeding production orgs. Cognito callback URLs (already per Auth stack). Merge to main. `cdk deploy --all`.
